paragraphs.text: Good morning, you're listening to GenWave, and that was Juniper Hollis with Paper Lanterns. {breath} Honestly? I could play that one all day. {laugh} Anyway, here's the weather.

Okay, quick bit of housekeeping, 'cause I kinda forgot last hour. The request line is open again. That number is 1-800-555-0199. One more time, nice and slow: 1-800, 555, 0199. Call it, text it, whatever you wanna do!
{um} Oh! And the bake sale at the hall tomorrow. Brownies are $2.50, lemon bars are $3, and the whole tray, if you're feeling brave, is $19.99. Gonna be honest with yah, I'm going for the tray.
Anyway. Weather today is... gorgeous. Sunny, high of 72, not a cloud anywhere. So get outside, would you!?
Lemme check something real quick here... um yeah... I think... yeah, got it!! OK, up next is that track I told you about, you're gonna love it!
It just doesn't get any better than that, really... {sigh} Man oh man {laugh} I love me some Metallica in the morning!
Up next, something a little slower. {pause} Here's the Marlowe Twins with Velvet Static, right here on GenWave.
